info.description: The public interface of Team Rota, defined before any implementation (design/PRODUCT-DESIGN.md v1.7, stories v1.7, agreed by both reviewers — D-02). Fields with a named validation code (role, reason codes, the shift's times and slots) are declared optional and read leniently so that the refusal order of the cross-cutting rules holds; a body that cannot be read into the operation's fields is invalid_request. Path ids are declared as integers; the API layer reads them leniently and answers invalid_request at the not_found step, after the caller is resolved. Every write answers the row it created or changed as its list or the board shows it; unassign answers nothing. Every operation carries an operationId <domain>.<action>, x-story traceability, x-roles from the permissions matrix, and named examples (x-synthetic: true) that the mock server serves and consumer tests use. Every refusal a story names is an explicit 4xx Problem with an enumerated reason. All times are naive local times of the team; every action reads now from the injected clock.
info.title: Team Rota API

post.description: One decide operation with an outcome. Approval transfers the assignment first and records the decision second, in one transaction; a refused transfer is recorded as a refused decision with the transfer's reason and the operation still succeeds (state changed). A reason with outcome approve, or a system code as the reason, is invalid_reason. Both members are notified, less an inactive one. The response is the request as the inbox lists it.
